coop.notes: P1 and P2 can each press one dendrite input; either player can scan and run the axon. Solo presses both inputs and runs the axon; the one-shot input triggers latch, so no second body is required.

authoring.notes: M2 Node Run: two dendrite inputs raise the stimulus counter to threshold, the threshold gate latches, and the terminal relay opens the exit. Automated unit, pack validation, smoke, and browser checks passed; human solo/co-op playtesting is pending. Uses prompt-obj-2 because per-level debrief prompts are not authored.
